                           Document Tracking Sheet



Meeting Date:                 5/26/2021
Sponsor(s):                   Dowell (3)
Type:                         Ordinance
Titie:                        Zoning Reclassification Map No. 4-E at 1838 S Prairie Ave
Committee(s) Assignment:      Committee on Zoning, Landmarks and Building Standards
                                    ORDINANCE


BE IT ORDAINED BY THE CITY COUNCIL OFTHE CITY OF CHICAGO:


SECTION 1. Title 17 ofthe Municipal Code ofChicago, the Chicago Zoning Ordinance,
Is hereby amended by changing all the Institutional Planned Development # 286
symbols and indications as shown on Map No 4-E in the area bounded by

       a line 394.83 feet south of and parallel to East 18th Street; South Prairie Avenue;
       a line 404.83 south of and parallel to East 18th Street; and the alley next east of
       and parallel to South Prairie Avenue

to those of a DX-3, Downtown Mixed-Use District.

SECTION 2. This ordinance shall be in force and effect from and after its passage and
due publication.




                                             Pat Dowell
                                             Alderman, 3^'' Ward




Common Address of Property:
1838 S Prairie Ave
